title: WPMS/559/2006 of ANAND GUPTA Vs H.N.B. GARHWAL UNIVERSITY and ORS

paras.text:
IN THE HIGH COURT OF UTTARANCHAL AT
NAINITAL
WRIT PETITION NO. 559 (MS) OF 2006
Anand Gupta, S/o Sri Hariom Gupta, R/o 202 South
Vanashthali, Ballupur Chowk, Dehradun.
 ..........Petitioner.
Versus
1. Hemwati Nandan Bahuguna Garhwal University Sri
Nagar Pauri Garhwal, through its Registrar.
2. Himalayan Institute of Technology, Dehradun, through
its Director.
3. Principal Himalayan Institute of Technology, Dehradun.
 .............Respondents.
Dated: 16.05.2006
Hon'ble Rajesh Tandon, J.
 Heard Sri Yogesh Pandey, Advocate for the petitioner
and Sri L.P. Naithani, Sr. Advocate, appearing on behalf of the
respondents. Both the parties have agreed that let the matter be
finally disposed of at the admission stage.
 By the present writ petition, the petitioner has prayed for
a writ of mandamus commanding the respondents to declare
the result of the petitioner's B.S.C. I.T. Course IV and V
Semester and further direct to permit the petitioner to appear in
the Examination of VIth Semester of the said course.
 Briefly stated, according to the case of the petitioner,
after completing his intermediate education, he got admission in
B.Sc. I.T. Course 2003-06 in the Himalayan Institute of
Technology, Dehradun, which is affiliated with Hemwati Nandan
Bahuguna, Garhwal University. He has also appeared in the
examintation of 3rd semester as a regular student.

However, result of the 3rd semester was declared and the
petitioner was shown as unsuccessful candidate and was
permitted to appear in back examination. He appeared in the
IVth and Vth Semester also.
 According to the further case of the petitioner, due to
some unfair means, he has not been permitted to prosecute
further study.
 The petitioner has made a representation, but the same
has not yet been disposed of.
 Petitioner is permitted to make a fresh representation
within a period of three days from the date of production of the
certified copy of the order. If such a representation is filed, the
same shall be disposed of before 22nd May, 2006 by assigning
reasons for not permitting the petitioner to prosecute further
studies.
 Writ petition is disposed of accordingly. No order as to
costs.
 Copy of the order to be given today.
(Rajesh Tandon, J.)
16.05.2006
Rathour
